title: astragalus arctus
intro: Astragalus arctus, commonly known as Mongolian milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus arctus include its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress, and its ability to promote cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
